name: Mortal Coil
source:
You...are dead! You've been sent to the next stage of existence which, unfortunately, isn't the afterlife just yet.  Because you don't remember how you died, you must return to Earth for approximately one year. You must live your new life at Willowcrest Community College, and through the bonds you create with others, figure out how you died. Only then can you pass on?

[From [url=https://ashthebat.itch.io/mortal-coil-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
